messages:
kevin: Quick sketch — ran hybrid FP8+4bit kernels on mistral-7b and qwen-7b with our new batch heuristic. Notable: Mistral saw ~18% token throughput gain, Qwen regressed ~12% when KV hits >128 steps. Repro steps below.
anna: thanks — can you paste the bench command and hardware? also which quant profile used?
kevin: hw: a100-80gb (m40-prod) and p3-staging. quant profiles: hybrid_fp8_4b_v2 for mistral, fallback-int8 for qwen. Command used:
```
./perf_bench --model qwen-7b --profile hybrid_fp8_4b_v2 --seq 1024 --batch 4 --kv-warmup 200 --duration 60
```
raj: did you try disabling KV caching? seems like qwen's attention layout hates the kv copy pattern in 4bit path.
kevin: yes — with kv_cache disabled qwen perf improves back to baseline but output quality degrades for long-context tests. it's a tradeoff.
sara: any logs or flamegraphs? can you dump nvprof and kernel names — want to see if we hit int8 fallback kernels.
kevin: short flame snippet shows heavy time in matmul_fp8_to_int8_kernel and kv_copy_small_chunks kernel. attaching in PR. perf-bot posted an automated alert too.
perf-bot: ALERT: nightly-regression: qwen-7b hybrid_fp8_4b_v2 throughput -12% vs baseline at 2029-03-14T02:00Z
mike: is this the same regression from last week? that one was batching-related, could be selector choosing matmul_fp8_unfused vs fused_int8 for certain seq lengths.
kevin: different pattern — last week was batching. this correlates with KV chunking size >256 bytes: kernel selector chose a conservative path that funnels through fp8->int8 conversions.
anna: suggestion — try forcing `--kernel-preference fused_int8` and `--kv-chunk-size 128` to see if we can restore perf without full disabling of cache.
kevin: tried that: fused_int8 + kv-chunk 128 gets qwen to -3% vs baseline and maintains quality on long-dialogue-1000. i'll add microbench + quant eval.
raj: please share microbench numbers and the eval prompts; i'll run the same on mistral to ensure fused_int8 doesn't harm fp8 gains.
kevin: tiny CSV attached to thread and eval set name 'long-dialogue-1000'.
kevin: CSV: "model,profile,kv_chunk,throughput_tokens/s,quality_p99"
"mistral-7b,hybrid_fp8_4b_v2,256,12000,0.95"
"qwen-7b,hybrid_fp8_4b_v2,256,8800,0.94"
"qwen-7b,fused_int8,128,10500,0.93"
anna: ok looks promising. let's add this to the shared config repo under profiles/experimental/hybrid4fp8/ with notes about kv_chunk and kernel hints.
kevin: will open PR with perf numbers + recommended flags. cc @sara @raj
sara: also include a small script to reproduce flamegraphs and exact git hashes of kernels/runtime.
kevin: yup — PR coming in ~1h :thumbsup:
anna: nice work. once PR is up i'll run full regression suite on dedicated pool.
mike: FYI, create a short canary job to roll fused_int8 on qwen-7b in a low-traffic region first.
kevin: done — canary scheduled for tomorrow. thanks all.
